data.name: Gunavathi
data.gender_notes: Gunavathi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Gunavathi is a Sanskrit name for the goddess of goodness and virtue. It is derived from the words 'gu' meaning 'good' and 'vathi' meaning 'she who holds'. The name symbolizes the embodiment of virtues such as wisdom, compassion, and strength. The name Gunavathi carries the meaning “Goddess of Goodness” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gunavathi usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of goodness and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gunavathi total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Gunavathi is a name that embodies virtue and goodness. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'gunas' (virtues) and 'vathi' (one who possesses or embodies). Thus, Gunavathi signifies a person who embodies virtues and inspires goodness in others.
